name: Zoran Kovačić
bio:
Zoran Kovačić brings over two decades of experience in the culinary arts to the Racing Bulls team. Starting his career in a small family-owned restaurant on the Dalmatian coast, Zoran quickly developed a passion for creating memorable dining experiences. His journey into motorsport began unexpectedly when he catered a small event for a local racing team, sparking an interest that led him to pursue opportunities within the industry.

At Racing Bulls, Zoran is responsible for managing all aspects of the team's catering, from daily meals for the drivers and crew to VIP events and hospitality. His approach is rooted in providing high-quality, nutritious food that fuels peak performance, while also offering a taste of home and comfort on the road. Zoran distinguishes himself through his commitment to sourcing fresh, local ingredients whenever possible and his knack for creating innovative menus that cater to diverse dietary needs and preferences. He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team, and he strives to create a positive and supportive environment through the power of food.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Zoran is a stout man with a warm smile and kind eyes, often seen wearing a crisp chef's jacket.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with new recipe ideas.
Insists on playing Croatian folk music in the kitchen during prep time.
Secretly taste-tests every dish at least three times before it leaves the kitchen.
